activeReplacementDecision.sourceSpan: Fachanforderungen Mathematik Sekundarstufe, Schleswig-Holstein 2024, Leitidee 2: Messen, Zeile 3321
activeReplacementDecision.rationale: This source transition is the limiting transition from difference quotient to derivative, on printed p63 with intuitive limits, secant/tangent slope and numerical local-change computation in the same table block. It is not a stochastic transition process. The two atomic targets jointly distinguish conceptual instantaneous rate and numerical/graphical quotient limit; partial links do not claim each atom exhausts every table instruction.

activeReplacementDecision.sourceSpan: Fachanforderungen Mathematik Sekundarstufe, Schleswig-Holstein 2024, Leitidee 4: Funktionaler Zusammenhang, Zeile 3530
activeReplacementDecision.rationale: This source transition changes a function graph under vertical/horizontal addition and multiplication. Printed p66 expressly lists shifts, scaling and both axis reflections in the same block. The three atomic targets describe precisely these actions; they do not establish a matrix, Markov or fixed-vector obligation, and this correction does not independently map the more demanding combined term or derivative-symmetry task.
